macros.name: abslabeldelim
macros.doc: The contents of \abslabeldelim are typeset after a run-in heading.

macros.name: absnamepos
macros.doc: \absnamepos specifies the name of the environment in which the abstract name is typeset.

macros.name: abstitleskip
macros.doc: Without the runin option \abstitleskip is aditional vertical space (either positive or negative) that is inserted between the abstract name and the text of the abstract.

macros.name: abstitlestyle
macros.doc: When the style option is called this macro is called to typeset the abstract heading; it should be redefined by the user to suit.

macros.name: saythanks
macros.doc: This macro typesets any \thanks commands after using onecolabstract.

envs.name: onecolabstract
envs.doc: If you want, you can use the onecolabstract environment in place of the abstract environment — it doesn’t have to be within the optional argument of the \twocolumn command.
